d: To the left, the entrance of a dark cave. - At the bottom, roads that cross the quadrivio represented by the seabed. - To the right a thick forest. - It is the dawn. Fishermen, Archers and Boscaiuoli followed by their Women come into the scene from various directions. A group of old people with loads of wood on the head comes out of the wood. Some Boscaiuoli are already in the stage, intent on cutting a tree trunk.

The clouds gradually disappearing, they will let see an alpine site with high rocks that can be practiced in a kind of closed breast formed by the Rhine. Among the peaked rocks black deep caves. To the left, beyond the river, a protruding rock. In the distance, the beach of Oberwesel. Chorus of Ninfe del Reno and Spirits of the air.

To the right is the castle of Margravius to which it ascends for a staircase. - In the distance, among the tall plants of a forest, you can see the crenellated towers of Walter's castle. - To the left, diagonally at the bottom, a small church of Gothic style belonging to the castle of Margravius. - At the bottom runs widely the Rhine, on the opposite bank of which you can see protruding the rock of Loreley. - On the front, on the left, a small source surrounded by shady plants and statues. - Morning light. At the rising of the canvas Anna is sitting at the source, surrounded by some Damigelle and her Vassalle. Anna is dressed in white, but still has not the mantle, the veil and the wedding crown.

The beach of Oberwesel. In the middle of the Rhine. Beyond the Rhine, on the right, the cliff of the Loreley. On the left the head of a bridge (practical) and a cross. Beyond the river forests of firs and rocks. A very lively sunset that illuminates the rock.
